title: Ridge Road Brick Farmhouse (c.1890)
description: A handsome 1890s brick farmhouse with original hardwood floors, a wraparound porch, and a restored two-story bank barn. Eight-plus acres of gently rolling pasture bordered by mature hedgerow. The kitchen was tastefully updated with soapstone counters and a farmhouse sink while preserving original pine plank floors and the wide-plank staircase. The wraparound porch runs the full front and south side. The bank barn has been re-roofed, re-wired, and has 200-amp service. Property includes a spring-fed stock pond, fenced paddock, and a graveled farm lane to the rear parcel.
outbuildings: Bank barn (restored, 200-amp), spring house, equipment shed

title: Mill Run Land Parcel — 38 Acres
address: 62 Mill Run Rd, Mill Creek, PA 00000
description: Thirty-eight acres of mostly tillable ground along Mill Run, currently leased for row crops at $185/acre annually. Road frontage on Mill Run Road, public water available at the roadside, and a complete soil map on file showing predominantly Class II Hagerstown silt loam. Approximately 32 acres tillable with 6 acres of mature timber and creek corridor. Excellent investment or future homesite — perc evaluation scheduled for October. No current structures. Survey on file. Tenant lease runs through December and can be continued or terminated at buyer's option.
lot_features: 32 ac tillable, 6 ac timber/creek corridor, Class II Hagerstown silt loam

title: Wheatland Farmhouse & Outbuildings — 12.4 Acres
address: 1420 Orchard Farm Rd, North Ridge, PA 00000
description: A well-kept 1970s farmhouse fully updated with a quartz kitchen, two renovated baths, new HVAC, and a standing-seam metal roof (2021). The 40×60 steel-framed pole barn has 14-ft clearance, concrete floor, and 200-amp service. Twelve-plus acres: fenced pasture with a spring-fed pond, 3 acres in hay, and a graveled entry lane flanked by mature hardwoods. Dual-zone HVAC, central vacuum, attached two-car garage. Long-time cattle operation but turnkey for horses, a market garden, or a hobby farm.
green_features: Solar panels, energy-star appliances, low-E windows
smart_home: Smart thermostat, security cameras, smart locks
outbuildings: 40×60 steel pole barn (200-amp), spring-fed pond, equipment storage

title: Ridge Lane Cottage — Walkable to Downtown
description: A move-in-ready mid-century cottage three blocks from the square, with hardwood floors throughout, an updated kitchen with shaker cabinets and subway tile, and a beautifully screened wraparound porch facing the private backyard. The primary suite was added in 2018 with a walk-in closet and tiled en-suite bath. The fenced, level back yard backs up to a mature tree line. Off-street parking for two, full unfinished basement with laundry. New windows and roof 2020. Natural gas, public water, public sewer. Perfect starter, downsizer, or in-town pied-à-terre close to county services, restaurants, and the Farmers Market.
green_features: Low-E windows, LED lighting, energy-star appliances
lot_features: Level fenced backyard, screened porch, mature tree line

title: Creek Bottom Grazing Land — 45 Acres
address: 215 Creek Bottom Rd, Mill Creek, PA 00000
description: Forty-five acres of fenced creek-bottom pasture with a run-in shed, gravity-fed stock waterer, and a creek corridor that never goes dry. Long history as grazing ground for a commercial beef operation — four paddocks, permanent fencing, and a hay field in the southwest corner. Road frontage with a graveled farm lane. Electricity at the road. A perc site was identified near the high ground on the north end, making this a strong future homesite as well as an operating farm. Seller will consider a land contract for qualified buyers.
lot_features: 4 paddocks, permanent fencing, hay field, graveled lane

title: Oak Ridge Orchard Farm — 60 Acres
description: A sixty-acre producing apple and peach orchard — under sale contract; reference sale. 4,200+ trees across 12 varieties managed under an Integrated Pest Management program with documented yield records for the past 8 seasons. Renovated farmhouse, cold storage building, fruit grading station, and roadside farm stand. Rare turn-key opportunity to continue an established, profitable orchard operation with an existing wholesale account.
outbuildings: Cold storage building, fruit grading station, farm stand, equipment storage

title: The Stone Homestead (c.1852) — 22 Acres
address: 310 Orchard Ridge Rd, Oak Hollow, PA 00000
description: A coursed-limestone homestead dating to 1852, carefully maintained through six generations and now offered for the first time in 40 years. Original summer kitchen, a two-story spring house, a three-bay bank barn with a 1920 addition, and a newer 30×50 equipment building. The main house retains original wide-plank floors, deep-silled windows, a walk-in hearth, and two additional fireplaces. Updated plumbing, new electrical panel, and a modern HVAC overlay. National Register nomination research available on request.
historic_designation: Listed 1852 stone-and-frame homestead; National Register research on file
outbuildings: Summer kitchen, two-story spring house, 3-bay bank barn, 30×50 equipment building

title: Hill View Building Lot — 5.5 Acres
address: 0 Hill View Rd, Oak Hollow, PA 00000
description: A wooded 5.5-acre building lot at 960-ft elevation with long-range ridge views to the west. Perc-approved for a conventional septic system; electric at the road; deeded right-of-way across the shared access lane. Mature hardwoods throughout with a cleared building envelope near the road. Survey, soil test, and recorded perc certificate on file. Paved road frontage, no HOA. Minutes from Oak Hollow shops and county services.
lot_features: 960-ft elevation, wooded, long-range views, cleared building envelope, paved road frontage
view: Long-range ridge views to the west

title: Meadow View Ranch — Updated & Move-In Ready
address: 2280 Meadow View Drive, Oak Hollow, PA 00000
description: Beautifully updated single-story ranch on 1.2 level acres at the edge of Oak Hollow. The 2023 renovation touched everything buyers want: quartz counters, LVP flooring throughout, custom tile baths, new roof, and complete HVAC replacement. Attached 2-car garage with epoxy floor and EV charging outlet. Full-width rear deck looks out over open farmland — rare combination of town convenience and country views. Natural gas, public water, public sewer. Bonus room above the garage is finished and heated.
green_features: Energy-star appliances, LED lighting, EV charging
smart_home: Smart thermostat, video doorbell, smart locks, security cameras
lot_features: Level 1.2-acre lot, full-width rear deck, views to open farmland

title: Mill Creek Road Farmette — 6 Acres
address: 771 Mill Creek Road, Mill Creek, PA 00000
description: A 1935 frame farmhouse on 6 level acres in the heart of Mill Creek township — the rare combination of a livable house, productive ground, and outbuildings, all under $400,000. Updated kitchen and bath, standing-seam metal roof. The 3-stall horse barn is in good repair with water and electric; additional equipment bays and chicken coop. Four acres of fenced pasture currently leased at $125/month. Horses, goats, laying hens — this property supports them all at a price that rarely comes to market in this township.
outbuildings: 3-stall horse barn (water & electric), equipment bays, chicken coop

title: Spring Valley Colonial — Sold in 8 Days
address: 445 Spring Valley Road, North Ridge, PA 00000
description: Sold in 8 days at full asking price. A 2004 colonial in the Spring Valley neighborhood — 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, 2-car garage, finished basement. Hardwood main level, granite kitchen, primary suite with tray ceiling and walk-in closet. Representative of the strength of the North Ridge market for move-in-ready in-town homes.
